schemes.name: PM Awas Yojana – Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U 2.0)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
schemes.benefit: Interest subsidy up to ₹1.80 lakh on home loans (EWS/LIG) under ISS vertical; affordable housing options in cities.
schemes.summary: Housing assistance for urban homeless and EWS/LIG families — interest subsidy on housing loans and affordable houses through PMAY-U 2.0 (2024–2030).

rules.note: PMAY-U covers urban areas only
Beneficiary family should not own a pucca house anywhere in India
EWS: up to ₹3L; LIG: ₹3–6L; MIG: ₹6–9L (PMAY-U 2.0 MIG ceiling ₹9L)

application_steps: Visit pmaymis.gov.in (PMAY-U 2.0 beneficiary portal) and click 'Citizen Assessment' / new registration
Enter Aadhaar, name, and family details; select category (EWS/LIG) by income
Choose vertical: ISS (interest subsidy on home loan) or Affordable Housing in Partnership (AHP)
Submit; note the application ID and track status on pmaymis.gov.in
For ISS subsidy approach any Scheduled Commercial Bank / HFC with the PMAY application ID

sources.name: IDBI Bank — PMAY-U 2.0 ISS FAQ (official bank PDF)

schemes.name: PM Awas Yojana – Gramin (PMAY-G)
schemes.benefit: Financial assistance for construction of a pucca house (~₹1.2–2 lakh depending on state/terrain; NE states get 90:10 central share).
schemes.summary: Pucca house for rural households who are homeless or living in kutcha houses, identified via SECC / Awaas+ lists.

rules.note: PMAY-G covers rural areas only
Household must be houseless or living in a kutcha/dilapidated house (SECC-based identification)
No family member should own a pucca house

application_steps: Check name in SECC-2011 permanent wait list / Awaas+ list with your Gram Panchayat
If not listed, apply to the Gram Panchayat for inclusion in the waiting list (survey-based)
Verification by Gram Panchayat + Block officials; geo-tagged construction after sanction
Funds in 3–4 installments directly to Aadhaar-linked bank account via PFMS/AwaasSoft
Track on pmayg.nic.in → 'Track Your Application'

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat – PM Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare / NHA
schemes.benefit: ₹5 lakh health cover per family per year for secondary/tertiary hospitalisation at empanelled public/private hospitals — fully cashless.
schemes.summary: World's largest health assurance scheme. Eligibility based on SECC 2011 deprivation/occupational criteria (bottom ~40%); also covers all senior citizens aged 70+ (Ayushman Vay Vandana) irrespective of income.

any_of.note: SECC-2011 deprivation-based eligibility for poor families
Ayushman Vay Vandana: every senior citizen aged 70+ gets the cover irrespective of income

application_steps: Check name in SECC-2011 list at beneficiary.nha.gov.in or call 14500 (national helpline)
Confirm/verify via Aadhaar e-KYC at the same portal or nearest CSC (Common Service Centre)
Download/verify Ayushman card from beneficiary.nha.gov.in or Umang app
Use card at any empanelled hospital Ayushman Mitra help desk — cashless treatment
Grievance: 14500 or state health agency

schemes.name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.benefit: ₹6,000 per year (3 installments of ₹2,000) directly into landholder farmer families' bank accounts.
schemes.summary: Income support for all landholding farmer families, subject to exclusions (institutional landholders, govt employees, income-tax payers, etc.).

rules.note: Cultivable landholding is primary eligibility (family = husband, wife, minor children)
Exclusion: former/present holders of constitutional posts, gazetted officers, regular government employees
Exclusion: income tax payers in last assessment year
Exclusion applies if ANY family member falls in exclusion categories

application_steps: Farmers can register on pmkisan.gov.in → 'New Farmer Registration'
Enter Aadhaar, land record (Khatauni/Kisan Bahi/pattadar passbook), bank details
eKYC via Aadhaar OTP at CSC or on pmkisan.gov.in (mandatory before credit)
Land record verification by state revenue/patwari; corrections via helpline
Track: pmkisan.gov.in → 'Beneficiary Status'

schemes.name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students (PMS-SC)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.benefit: Full tuition fee reimbursement + monthly maintenance allowance for post-matric courses (Class 11 onwards), paid via DBT.
schemes.summary: Centrally Sponsored Scholarship for SC students in recognised post-matriculation courses; family income from all sources must not exceed ₹2.5 lakh/year.

rules.note: Applicant must belong to Scheduled Caste
Must be enrolled in a recognised post-matriculation course (Class 11 and above)
Family income from all sources ≤ ₹2.5 lakh/year

application_steps: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) — scholarships.gov.in → 'New Registration'
Fill academic details, course, institution; generate 'Registration ID'
Upload income & caste certificate issued by competent authority
Institution + district verification on NSP; then PFMS DBT to Aadhaar-linked bank
Track application on NSP 'Check Your Status'

schemes.name: Post Matric Scholarship for OBC Students (PMS-OBC)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.benefit: Course fee + maintenance allowance for post-matric courses for OBC students, paid via DBT.
schemes.summary: Post-matric scholarship for OBC students; family income from all sources must not exceed ₹2.5 lakh/year (as per current DoSEJ guidelines).

rules.note: Applicant must belong to OBC category
Must be enrolled in a recognised post-matriculation course
Family income from all sources ≤ ₹2.5 lakh/year

application_steps: Register on National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) → 'New Registration'
Fill course/institution details; upload OBC caste + income certificate
Institute and district nodal verification on NSP
DBT via PFMS to Aadhaar-linked bank account
Track on NSP portal

schemes.name: PM Vishwakarma
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises + MSDE
schemes.benefit: Free skilling (₹500/day stipend), ₹15,000 toolkit incentive, collateral-free ₹1L→₹2L (up to ₹3L total) enterprise loans at 5% interest, digital transaction incentive ₹1/transaction.
schemes.summary: End-to-end support for artisans and craftspeople in 18 traditional trades — recognition + training + toolkit + credit + market linkage.

rules.note: Must be working with hands/tools in one of 18 eligible trades (carpenter, blacksmith, potter, tailor, cobbler, barber, goldsmith, etc.)
Minimum age 18 years on date of registration
Both rural and urban artisans eligible; unorganised sector, self-employed

application_steps: Register on pmvishwakarma.gov.in portal (self or via CSC)
Upload trade details + Aadhaar; choose your trade from the 18 listed
Verification by Gram Panchayat / ULB and district committee
Complete 5–7 day basic skilling (₹500/day stipend) → toolkit ₹15,000
After recognition certificate + ID card, apply for ₹1 lakh loan (first tranche) at 5% via bank

schemes.name: PM Street Vendor's Atma Nirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
schemes.benefit: Collateral-free working capital loans: ₹10,000 → ₹20,000 → ₹50,000 (progressive), 7% interest subsidy on timely repayment, ₹1,200/year cashback on digital transactions.
schemes.summary: Affordable micro-credit for urban street vendors/hawkers to resume and grow livelihoods.

rules.note: Must be a street vendor/hawker vending in urban areas on or before 24 March 2020 (original) or per current relaxed norms
Scheme targets vendors in urban areas (including peri-urban)
Minimum age 18 years

application_steps: Approach your ULB/municipality for Certificate of Vending (CoV) or Letter of Recommendation (LoR) if vending pre-2020 undocumented
Apply on pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or via lending institution / CSC
Provide Aadhaar + bank details; loan sanction in ~30 days
Repay on time to unlock 2nd (₹20k) and 3rd (₹50k) tranches + 7% subsidy
UdyamiMitra / ULB help desks for handholding

schemes.name: Stand-Up India
schemes.ministry: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
schemes.benefit: Bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore for greenfield enterprises (manufacturing, services, agri-allied, trading), composite loan incl. margin money + working capital.
schemes.summary: Facilitates loans for at least one SC/ST borrower and one woman borrower per bank branch to set up a greenfield enterprise.

any_of.note: At least one SC or ST borrower per branch (for greenfield enterprise)
At least one woman borrower per branch

rules.note: Borrower must be 18+ years
For setting up a NEW (greenfield) enterprise in manufacturing/services/trading/agri-allied

application_steps: Check eligibility & apply via standupmitra.in (SIDBI portal)
Choose bank branch; portal routes application to the selected bank
Prepare project report (portal has templates + handholding support)
Bank appraisal & sanction; composite loan includes term loan + working capital
Training/support via EDI and LSPs (incubation, skill training)

schemes.name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
schemes.benefit: Guaranteed pension ₹1,000–₹5,000/month from age 60 (5 slabs); spouse continues pension on death; nominee gets corpus back.
schemes.summary: Social security pension for unorganised-sector workers; join between 18–40 years with a bank account; contribution auto-debits till 60.

rules.note: Must be 18–40 years at enrolment
Must have a savings bank account (APY is bank-driven)
Open to unorganised-sector workers not covered by statutory social security

application_steps: Visit your bank branch (or use net-banking/mobile app) offering APY
Fill APY registration form; choose pension slab (₹1,000–₹5,000)
Ensure Aadhaar + mobile number linked for auto-debit mandate
Auto-debit starts monthly/quarterly/half-yearly (as chosen) till age 60
Pension from 60; track via bank / APY portal (npscra.nsdl.co.in)

sources.name: India Post / PFRDA — APY official page

schemes.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
schemes.benefit: Highest small-savings interest rate (~8.2% p.a., quarterly revised), EEE tax-exempt, partial withdrawal at 18 for education, maturity at 21 for girl's marriage/studies.
schemes.summary: Savings account for the girl child — open before she turns 10; deposit ₹250–₹1.5 lakh/year.

rules.note: Account can be opened for a girl child below 10 years (max 2 accounts per family, exceptions for twins/triplets)
Open at any post office or authorised bank branch (guardian operates it)

application_steps: Visit nearest post office or authorised bank branch with girl's birth certificate
Fill SSY account opening form (Form-SSY-1); nominee = guardian details
Initial deposit ₹250 (minimum); set annual deposits up to ₹1.5 lakh
Deposits for 15 years; account matures at 21 years from opening
Partial withdrawal up to 50% at 18 for education; closure for marriage after 18

schemes.name: PM Ujjwala Yojana 2.0 (PMUY 2.0)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
schemes.benefit: Free LPG connection (deposit-free cylinder + regulator + hose) + ₹300/refill DBT subsidy; deposit-free connection per current PMUY rules.
schemes.summary: Clean cooking fuel for women from poor households (BPL/SC/ST/SECC/ANTYODAYA etc.) — 10.35+ crore connections so far.

rules.note: Connection is issued in the name of an adult woman of the household
Women from BPL/SC/ST/PMAY/Antyodaya/SECC households are eligible
Adult woman (18+)

application_steps: Check eligibility at pmuy.gov.in and locate nearest LPG distributor
Apply on pmuy.gov.in (Ujjwala 2.0 form) or via distributor/CSC with KYC
Provide Aadhaar, bank details, ration card/BPL/SECC proof
Connection issued deposit-free per current rules
₹300 DBT subsidy per refill to Aadhaar-linked account (up to 12 refills/year cap as applicable)

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
schemes.benefit: Central assistance ₹200/month (60–79 years) or ₹500/month (80+); states often top up ₹200–₹2,000.
schemes.summary: Old-age pension for BPL seniors aged 60+; amount credited quarterly via DBT along with state top-ups.

rules.note: Applicant must belong to a BPL household (as per state BPL list / SECC)

application_steps: Apply to your Block/Municipal office or Gram Panchayat (NSAP application form)
Submit age proof + BPL proof + bank details
Sanction by district social welfare officer; pension via DBT (quarterly)
Track on nsap.nic.in → 'Track Pension' / state portals
Grievance: state social welfare department or nsap.nic.in helpline
